Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the author of "The New New Rules" as Bill Maher. Bill Maher is the author of "The New Rules of Marriage" (and other books), but "The New New Rules" is a book by Bill Clinton. This fundamental error led the entire multi-agent process to search for the wrong TV show (Real Time with Bill Maher) instead of the correct one associated with Bill Clinton (likely "The New New Rules" podcast or related content), resulting in an answer about the wrong entity.
